_comment: irrd-3a baseline for confidence_calibration (MAE of |confidence_score - overall_f1| across services/eval/fixtures/expected/*.json). The MAE <= 0.3 gate in src/metrics/confidence_calibration.py reads `threshold`, not this baseline: `mae` here is trend context only (delta_vs_baseline in the run summary). Re-generate with the documented opt-in command and copy the reported values here along with the commit SHA.
